As per the Circular Ref: IRDA/NL/CIR/MOT/137/08/2018 dated 28th August, 2018 on implementation of the Directions of the Hon'ble Supreme Court of India in the matter 

It is hereby reiterated that long term motor product permitted under para 2(i), 5 (i) shall be offered only to **new private cars and new two-wheelers.** These products **shall** However, Long Term Two Wheeler Insurance Policy being issued for three-years as **not be offered** for renewal of existing policies or for old vehicles.
